blurb: Sip, swirl, and sample southern muscadine wines. Emerald Coast Wine Cellars opened its doors August 2001. Since then, we have been providing wines to all the wonderful people visiting the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. We offer a complimentary wine tasting daily, 7 days a week.
